name: exa
description: Web search and page contents for agents
long_description: Bring an API key from your existing Exa account to search the web and retrieve page contents. The gateway keeps the key off your Sprites. Saving or replacing a key and each connection test run a one-result search charged to your Exa account. Only POST /search and POST /contents are forwarded.

examples.title: Search the web (uses your Exa credits)

messages.402: Exa credits exhausted or spending limit reached
messages.403: Exa key does not have access to this request
messages.429: Exa rate limit reached; try again later

presentation.tagline: Search the web and retrieve page contents without storing your Exa key on a Sprite.
presentation.setup: Create an API key at dashboard.exa.ai/api-keys.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or replacing a key and each connection test run a one-result search charged to your Exa account. Searches and page content requests also use your Exa credits.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /search` and `POST /contents` are forwarded. The gateway supplies your stored key; do not copy it into your Sprite.
